turns.text: user just logged in by mobile OTP, but profile call says ABDM-1094 X-token expired. token is brand new, why?

must_contain: A profile call refused with ABDM-1094 X-token expired on a new token usually means the token from login verify was sent instead of the one from /abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify/user.
Send the verify token as the T-token header to /abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify/user and use the token it returns as the X-token.
ABDM-1094 arrives with code at the top level beside a timestamp, not inside an error object, so read the code inside error when present and fall back to the top level code.
notes: The message says expired but the token is fresh; the real cause is sending the wrong one of two login tokens. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/flows/m1-login-by-mobile.md, 'A profile call refused with `ABDM-1094`, X-token expired, on a new token usually means the token from login verify was sent instead of the one from verify user'; 'Always call `/abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify/user` with the chosen `ABHANumber`, the same `txnId` and that token in the `T-token` header ... It returns the `X-token` profile calls need.' catalogue/hiecm/errors/abdm-1094.md, 'This code arrives with `code` at the top level beside a `timestamp`, while other M1 errors wrap it in an `error` object. Read the `code` inside `error` when it is present, and fall back to the top level `code`.'
